title: 5-Year Tax-Saving Bank Fixed Deposits
source: Reserve Bank of India & Income Tax Rules (Income Tax Act 1961 & Income Tax Act 2025)
reference: Section 80C (recodified as Section 123 under Income Tax Act 2025)
content: Tax-Saving Bank FDs offer: 1. Lock-in: Mandatory 5 years with zero premature withdrawal or pledge against loan permitted. 2. Tax Relief: Principal up to ₹1,50,000 qualifies for Section 80C deduction (recodified as Section 123 under Income Tax Act 2025). 3. Taxation of Returns: Interest earned is fully taxable as income from other sources at the investor's applicable tax slab rate. TDS applies if interest exceeds threshold.
